title: Pricing & allowances
intro: What a stall gets free, and what it pays to go beyond it. A change here reaches every stall at the start of the next day, and stalls are told a week before anything goes up.

scope.title: Charging Farmers is not in the SRS.
scope.text: The SRS rules out a payment gateway. Until that is resolved, credit is arranged off the platform and entered here by an admin.

currency.title: Currency stalls are charged in
currency.text: Customers always pay cash at the stall, so this is only what the platform bills a Farmer.

rounding.title: Round prices to
rounding.text: Keeps the numbers readable on a small screen.

notice.title: Notice before a rise
notice.text: How long stalls see a new price before it applies.

free.title: Free allowance
free.text: Every approved stall gets this without paying. Set it high enough that a small grower never has to pay.
free.listingsHint: Cô Tư Garden lists 3 on a busy day.

prices.title: Prices
prices.note: A day pinned on a market page is about 7% of what a stall takes on one market morning. Keep that ratio in view when you change these.

pins.title: Pinned slots
pins.note: Scarcity is the product. Raising these numbers earns more today and makes every page look more like advertising.

earned.title: What this earned
earned.note: Totals and the split by stall are on the revenue report.

adjust.title: Adjust every price at once?
adjust.text: Moves each price by the same percentage and rounds to the nearest 1,000 ₫. Use it for inflation rather than for a change of strategy.
adjust.changeByHint: Per cent. A negative number lowers them.
adjust.whenNotice: In 7 days, after stalls are told
adjust.whenNextMonth: At the start of next month
adjust.example: A market-page day would go from {{from}} to {{to}}.

toast.saved: Prices saved. Stalls will be told a week before they take effect.
toast.adjusted: Every price moved by {{pct}}%. Stalls are told today and it applies in 7 days.
